ex.en: The challenge we are going to face is how to increase work efficiency.
ex.zh: 我們要面對的挑戰是如何提高工作效率。

ex.en: We have optimized the database indexing, and as a result, system efficiency has improved by 50%.
ex.zh: 我們優化了資料庫索引，系統效率因此提高了 50%。

ex.en: If you make a study plan, you can make progress efficiently.
ex.zh: 只要擬定讀書計畫，就能有效率地進步。

ex.en: We need to use our resources more efficiently.
ex.zh: 我們需要更有效率地運用資源。

ex.en: The new system processes orders efficiently.
ex.zh: 新系統能有效率地處理訂單。

ex.en: We need to measure the effectiveness of the campaign.
ex.zh: 我們需要評估這次活動的成效。

ex.en: Studies have proved the effectiveness of the vaccine.
ex.zh: 研究已證實這種疫苗的效力。

ex.en: Pollution has a disastrous effect on the ecology of a region.
ex.zh: 汙染對一個地區的生態有災難性的影響。

ex.en: It has had no effect on him.
ex.zh: 這對他毫無影響。

ex.en: The effects of the medicine were wearing off.
ex.zh: 藥效漸漸退了。

ex.en: Possible side effects include blurred vision and shortness of breath.
ex.zh: 可能的副作用包括視力模糊和呼吸急促。

ex.en: This medicine has no serious side effects.
ex.zh: 這種藥沒有嚴重的副作用。

ex.en: The new rules will take effect next month.
ex.zh: 新規定下個月生效。

ex.en: The new policy takes effect on July 1.
ex.zh: 新政策七月一日起生效。

ex.en: With a little more effort, he would have succeeded.
ex.zh: 他當時再努力一點就成功了。

ex.en: They made a great effort to settle the problem.
ex.zh: 他們盡了很大努力解決這個問題。

ex.en: Whether you succeed or not depends on your own efforts.
ex.zh: 你成功與否取決於你自己的努力。

ex.en: Preventive measures are much more effective than the actual treatment.
ex.zh: 預防措施比實際治療有效得多。

ex.en: Patience is sometimes the most effective weapon.
ex.zh: 耐心有時是最有效的武器。

ex.en: The doctor is looking for medicine that is effective for this illness.
ex.zh: 醫生正在尋找能有效治療這種疾病的藥。

ex.en: The new rules will be effective from Monday.
ex.zh: 新規定將從星期一起生效。

ex.en: The price change is effective immediately.
ex.zh: 價格調整立即生效。

ex.en: We need to use our time more effectively.
ex.zh: 我們需要更有效地運用時間。

ex.en: The new software helps teams communicate effectively.
ex.zh: 新軟體能幫助團隊有效溝通。

ex.en: The decision effectively ended the project.
ex.zh: 這個決定實際上讓專案劃下了句點。

ex.en: He is effectively running the company now.
ex.zh: 他現在實際上是在經營這家公司。

ex.en: There is no denying that she is very efficient.
ex.zh: 不可否認，她做事非常有效率。

ex.en: As people get older, their brain cells become less efficient.
ex.zh: 隨著年紀增長，腦細胞的效率會變差。

ex.en: The new system is faster and more efficient.
ex.zh: 新系統更快也更有效率。
